# openmetadata_glossary_term (Data Source)

Looks up a single OpenMetadata glossary term by id or fully qualified name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_glossary_term" "petty_cash" {
  fully_qualified_name = "finance.PettyCash"
}

output "petty_cash_term_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_glossary_term.petty_cash.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Glossary term fully qualified name. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.
- `id` (String) Glossary term UUID. Exactly one of id or fully_qualified_name must be set.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Markdown description.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `glossary` (String) Fully qualified name of the glossary that owns the term.
- `mutually_exclusive` (Boolean) Whether a term may belong to only one glossary under the same parent.
- `name` (String) Term name.
- `parent` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent term, if any.
- `synonyms` (List of String) Alternative names for the term.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.
